method: Actual CUA-controlled Codex in-app browser on http://127.0.0.1:8769. Native dropdowns, buttons and text entry; no browser-side test bypass.
scope: Iterative UI tests. All four tasks exercised during development; final built HTML reloaded and rules cycle plus static disclosures retested after feedback-only wording refinement.
observed_checks: Blank predictions/reason block evidence; blank explanation blocks feedback.
Window 2.5 ms: INVALID with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; deliberately wrong FAIL prediction received corrective feedback.
Changing window to 4 ms clears active prediction; previous attempt retained; INVALID with FAIL.
Matched HVL comparison reached VALID/PASS for corrected target and credited known upstream correction.
Rules at 1.5 ms / 0.9 V / 1 ms: VALID measurement, FAIL scalar, PASS T1; final text states 1.126 ms measured delay.
Task switching preserves completed attempts; forms restart with unanswered predictions.
Enlarge waveform opens modal and Close returns to experiment.
Challenge initial preview limited to 4.4 ms; extension unavailable before required reasoning and feedback.
Challenge requires next evidence and proposed check; initial INVALID/INSUFFICIENT preserved when 6 ms additional evidence shows VALID/PASS.
Local JSON export downloaded; two automated attempts verified, original challenge judgment preserved.
Script-free worksheet evidence and feedback disclosures opened successfully; real-recording label visible.
Final browser console error query returned no errors.
limitations: file:// navigation blocked by browser protocol policy; no alternative surface used. Direct double-click entry not empirically validated.
Self-contained offline architecture checked by source/payload tests; actual UI run used loopback HTTP, not a network-disconnected browser trial.
No mobile, cross-browser or screen-reader usability claim. Free text is not automatically graded.
Automated software operation is not independent reader evaluation.
